entities.summary: Gordon Gray was an American attorney and government official during the administrations of Harry Truman (1945–53) and Dwight Eisenhower (1953–61) associated with defense and national security. Gordon Gray was a legal figures from Baltimore (1909-05-30, Baltimore–1982-11-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
